basic_info.description: Situated on a nearly 3k sqft lot, this is an inviting home capturing the best of the Central Sunset lifestyle. With its west-facing orientation and expansive ocean views, the property enjoys natural light and stunning sunsets. Perfectly positioned, half a block from vibrant neighborhood amenities, you'll have restaurants, shops, cafes, banks, and grocery stores all within short walking distance, plus easy access to the Noriega bus line for downtown or city commuting. Quick access to route 1 allows for a short commute to the South Bay, or Golden Gate Park and Marin to the north. The expansive west-facing landscaped yard offers multiple areas to relax, entertain, or garden, creating a private retreat just minutes from some of the most popular Sunset destinations. Inside, you'll find a well-maintained home with interior garage + BONUS ROOM access and future upside potential whether you choose to expand, renovate, add a second bath, or enjoy it exactly as it is. This is a rare opportunity to own in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, with the flexibility to make it your own. Note: bonus room down could be used as a 3rd bedroom, office or den.
